lead: A parser refusal that yields `ExprKind::Error` doubles its own `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block.
body: `Error` types as `mixed`, so every binding fed by one reports an `E0401` beside the refusal that caused it, once per site. Prefer handing the *operand* back in place of the refused prefix; `parse_unary` in `crates/nvs-syntax/src/parser/expr.rs` keeps `Error` only for a cast naming a type it cannot produce. Decide which a new refusal wants before writing the expected block.
